us: Navy helicopter disables M/T Vela Nova
effects: Two Hellfires · ~71nm off Pakistani coast · Third vessel disabled
tldr: A Navy helicopter fired two Hellfire missiles into the Vela Nova some 71 nautical miles off the Pakistani coast — the third vessel forcibly disabled under the blockade, and proof that enforcement stayed lethal while talks stayed stalled.

sources.title: GlobalSecurity.org — Iran War daily ops report
